mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRX_TASK (ID, CORP_ID, MENU_CD, SRVC_CD, REF_NO, STATUS, CURRENT_STAGE_SEQ, REM_ACCT_NO, BEN_ACCT_NO, BEN_ACCT_NM, TRX_AMT, TRX_CCY_CD, REMARK1, REMARK2, REMARK3, INSTRUCTION_MODE, INSTRUCTION_DT, MAKER_USER_ID, MAKER_USER_NAME, IS_SINGLE_USER, VERSION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_DT, BEN_DOM_BNK_ID, BEN_BNK_CD, BEN_BNK_NM, BEN_BNK_BIC, BEN_ADDR_1, BEN_ADDR_2, BEN_ADDR_3, BEN_PHONE, BEN_POSTAL_CD, BEN_ID_TYPE, BEN_ID_NO, BEN_TYPE, LLD_IS_REM_RES, LLD_IS_BEN_RES, FEE_AMT, DEBIT_CCY_CD, DEBIT_AMT, EXCHANGE_RATE, BASE_AMT, RATE_TYPE, SOURCE_PRODUCT_TYPE, ADVISORY_MSG, UND_DOC_TYPE, UND_DOC_NO, UND_DOC_NM, UND_DOC_AMT, UND_DOC_EXPIRY, VA_INQUIRY_REQ_ID, BIFAST_PURPOSE_CD, BIFAST_CRED_ID, BIFAST_CRED_TYPE, BIFAST_CRED_ACCT_TYPE, BIFAST_CRED_RSDNT_STS, BIFAST_CRED_TOWN, BIFAST_SETTLEMENT_DT, PROXY_TYPE, PROXY_ID) VALUES (#{id}, #{corpId}, #{menuCd}, #{srvcCd}, #{refNo}, #{status}, #{currentStageSeq}, #{remAcctNo}, #{benAcctNo}, #{benAcctNm}, #{trxAmt}, #{trxCcyCd}, #{remark1}, #{remark2}, #{remark3}, #{instructionMode}, SYSDATE, #{makerUserId}, #{makerUserName}, #{isSingleUser}, 0, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE, #{domestic.benDomBnkId}, #{domestic.benBnkCd}, #{domestic.benBnkNm}, #{domestic.benBnkBic}, #{domestic.benAddr1}, #{domestic.benAddr2}, #{domestic.benAddr3}, #{domestic.benPhone}, #{domestic.benPostalCd}, #{domestic.benIdType}, #{domestic.benIdNo}, #{domestic.benType}, #{domestic.lldIsRemRes}, #{domestic.lldIsBenRes}, #{domestic.feeAmt}, #{cross.debitCcyCd}, #{cross.debitAmt}, #{cross.exchangeRate}, #{cross.baseAmt}, #{cross.rateType}, #{cross.sourceProductType}, #{cross.advisoryMsg}, #{cross.undDocType}, #{cross.undDocNo}, #{cross.undDocNm}, #{cross.undDocAmt}, #{cross.undDocExpiry}, #{vaInquiryReqId}, #{bifast.purposeCd}, #{bifast.credId}, #{bifast.credType}, #{bifast.credAcctType}, #{bifast.credRsdntSts}, #{bifast.credTown}, #{bifast.settlementDt}, #{bifast.proxyType}, #{bifast.proxyId})

INSERT INTO TRX_TASK_STAGE (ID, TRX_TASK_ID, SEQ_NO, STAGE_TYPE, APRV_LVL_CD, USR_GRP_OPT, CORP_USR_GRP_ID, REQUIRED_COUNT, COMPLETED_COUNT, STATUS, VERSION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_DT) VALUES (#{id}, #{trxTaskId}, #{seqNo}, #{stageType}, #{aprvLvlCd}, #{usrGrpOpt}, #{corpUsrGrpId}, #{requiredCount}, 0, #{status}, 0, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO TRX_TASK_ACTION (ID, TRX_TASK_ID, STAGE_SEQ, ACTION, ACTOR_USER_ID, ACTOR_USER_NAME, ACTOR_GROUP_ID, OTP_VERIFICATION_ID, NOTE, CREATED_DT) VALUES (#{id}, #{trxTaskId}, #{stageSeq}, #{action}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserName}, #{actorGroupId}, #{otpVerificationId}, #{note}, SYSDATE)

INSERT INTO TRX_TASK_CANDIDATE (ID, TRX_TASK_ID, STAGE_SEQ, USER_ID, CORP_USR_ID, USER_NAME, CORP_USR_GRP_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATED_DT) VALUES (#{id}, #{trxTaskId}, #{stageSeq}, #{userId}, #{corpUsrId}, #{userName}, #{corpUsrGrpId}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS "id", REF_NO AS "refNo", MENU_CD AS "menuCd", SRVC_CD AS "srvcCd", STATUS AS "status", CURRENT_STAGE_SEQ AS "currentStageSeq", TRX_AMT AS "trxAmt", TRX_CCY_CD AS "trxCcyCd", REM_ACCT_NO AS "remAcctNo", BEN_ACCT_NO AS "benAcctNo", BEN_ACCT_NM AS "benAcctNm", REMARK1 AS "remark1", MAKER_USER_NAME AS "makerUserName", CREATED_DT AS "createdDt", VERSION AS "version", CORE_JOURNAL AS "coreJournal", TRX_REF_NO AS "trxRefNo", EXECUTED_DT AS "executedDt", BEN_DOM_BNK_ID AS "benDomBnkId", BEN_BNK_NM AS "benBnkNm", BEN_BNK_CD AS "benBnkCd", BEN_BNK_BIC AS "benBnkBic", FEE_AMT AS "feeAmt", RETRIEVAL_REF_NO AS "retrievalRefNo", INTERBANK_RESPONSE_CD AS "interbankResponseCd", DEBIT_CCY_CD AS "debitCcyCd", DEBIT_AMT AS "debitAmt", EXCHANGE_RATE AS "exchangeRate", SOURCE_PRODUCT_TYPE AS "sourceProductType", ADVISORY_MSG AS "advisoryMsg", TWO_LEG_STATE AS "twoLegState", SIMSEM_ACCT_NO AS "simsemAcctNo", JOURNAL_NO_SIMSEM AS "journalNoSimsem", TRX_ID AS "trxId", END_TO_END_ID AS "endToEndId", BIFAST_PURPOSE_CD AS "bifastPurposeCd" FROM TRX_TASK WHERE CORP_ID = #{companyId} AND ID = #{taskId}

SELECT SEQ_NO AS "seqNo", STAGE_TYPE AS "stageType", APRV_LVL_CD AS "aprvLvlCd", USR_GRP_OPT AS "usrGrpOpt", REQUIRED_COUNT AS "requiredCount", COMPLETED_COUNT AS "completedCount", STATUS AS "status" FROM TRX_TASK_STAGE WHERE TRX_TASK_ID = #{taskId} ORDER BY SEQ_NO

SELECT STAGE_SEQ AS "stageSeq", ACTION AS "action", ACTOR_USER_NAME AS "actorUserName", NOTE AS "note", CREATED_DT AS "createdDt" FROM TRX_TASK_ACTION WHERE TRX_TASK_ID = #{taskId} ORDER BY CREATED_DT, ID

SELECT t.ID AS "id", t.REF_NO AS "refNo", t.MENU_CD AS "menuCd", t.STATUS AS "status", t.TRX_AMT AS "trxAmt", t.TRX_CCY_CD AS "trxCcyCd", t.REM_ACCT_NO AS "remAcctNo", t.BEN_ACCT_NO AS "benAcctNo", t.BEN_ACCT_NM AS "benAcctNm", t.REMARK1 AS "remark1", t.MAKER_USER_NAME AS "makerUserName", t.CREATED_DT AS "createdDt", s.SEQ_NO AS "stageSeq", s.STAGE_TYPE AS "stageType", s.REQUIRED_COUNT AS "requiredCount", s.COMPLETED_COUNT AS "completedCount" FROM TRX_TASK t JOIN TRX_TASK_STAGE s ON s.TRX_TASK_ID = t.ID AND s.SEQ_NO = t.CURRENT_STAGE_SEQ AND s.STATUS = N'ACTIVE' JOIN TRX_TASK_CANDIDATE c ON c.TRX_TASK_ID = t.ID AND c.STAGE_SEQ = s.SEQ_NO AND c.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE t.CORP_ID = #{companyId} AND t.STATUS IN (N'PENDING_APPROVAL', N'PENDING_RELEASE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRX_TASK_ACTION a WHERE a.TRX_TASK_ID = t.ID AND a.STAGE_SEQ = s.SEQ_NO AND a.ACTOR_USER_ID = c.CORP_USR_ID) ORDER BY t.CREATED_DT DESC, t.ID
mapper.update: UPDATE TRX_TASK SET STATUS = #{status}, CURRENT_STAGE_SEQ = #{currentStageSeq}, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{taskId} AND VERSION = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE TRX_TASK_STAGE SET COMPLETED_COUNT = #{completedCount}, STATUS = #{status}, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE TRX_TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND SEQ_NO = #{seqNo}
UPDATE TRX_TASK_STAGE SET STATUS = #{status}, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE TRX_TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND SEQ_NO = #{seqNo}
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS "id", CORP_ID AS "corpId", MENU_CD AS "menuCd", SRVC_CD AS "srvcCd", REF_NO AS "refNo", STATUS AS "status", REM_ACCT_NO AS "remAcctNo", BEN_ACCT_NO AS "benAcctNo", BEN_ACCT_NM AS "benAcctNm", TRX_AMT AS "trxAmt", TRX_CCY_CD AS "trxCcyCd", REMARK1 AS "remark1", MAKER_USER_ID AS "makerUserId", VERSION AS "version", BEN_DOM_BNK_ID AS "benDomBnkId", BEN_BNK_CD AS "benBnkCd", BEN_BNK_BIC AS "benBnkBic", BEN_ADDR_1 AS "benAddr1", BEN_ADDR_2 AS "benAddr2", BEN_ADDR_3 AS "benAddr3", BEN_PHONE AS "benPhone", BEN_POSTAL_CD AS "benPostalCd", BEN_ID_TYPE AS "benIdType", BEN_ID_NO AS "benIdNo", BEN_TYPE AS "benType", LLD_IS_REM_RES AS "lldIsRemRes", LLD_IS_BEN_RES AS "lldIsBenRes", FEE_AMT AS "feeAmt", DEBIT_CCY_CD AS "debitCcyCd", DEBIT_AMT AS "debitAmt", BASE_AMT AS "baseAmt", RATE_TYPE AS "rateType", SOURCE_PRODUCT_TYPE AS "sourceProductType", VA_INQUIRY_REQ_ID AS "vaInquiryReqId", BIFAST_PURPOSE_CD AS "bifastPurposeCd", BIFAST_CRED_ID AS "bifastCredId", BIFAST_CRED_TYPE AS "bifastCredType", BIFAST_CRED_ACCT_TYPE AS "bifastCredAcctType", BIFAST_CRED_RSDNT_STS AS "bifastCredRsdntSts", BIFAST_CRED_TOWN AS "bifastCredTown", BIFAST_SETTLEMENT_DT AS "bifastSettlementDt", PROXY_TYPE AS "proxyType", PROXY_ID AS "proxyId" FROM TRX_TASK WHERE ID = #{taskId}
mapper.update:
UPDATE TRX_TASK SET STATUS = N'EXECUTING', VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{taskId} AND VERSION = #{expectedVersion}
AND STATUS IN (N'READY_TO_EXECUTE', N'QUEUED')

UPDATE TRX_TASK SET STATUS = N'EXECUTED', CORE_JOURNAL = #{coreJournal}, TRX_REF_NO = #{trxRefNo}, EXECUTED_DT = SYSDATE, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{taskId} AND STATUS = N'EXECUTING'
UPDATE TRX_TASK SET STATUS = #{status}, EXECUTED_DT = SYSDATE, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{taskId} AND STATUS = N'EXECUTING'
mapper.select: SELECT ACTOR_USER_ID FROM TRX_TASK_ACTION WHERE TRX_TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND ACTION = N'RELEASE' ORDER BY CREATED_DT DESC, ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE TRX_TASK_STAGE SET STATUS = N'CLOSED', VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE TRX_TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND STATUS IN (N'WAITING', N'ACTIVE')
UPDATE TRX_TASK SET RETRIEVAL_REF_NO = #{retrievalRefNo}, INTERBANK_RESPONSE_CD = #{responseCd}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{taskId}
UPDATE TRX_TASK SET TRX_ID = #{trxId}, END_TO_END_ID = #{endToEndId}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{taskId}
UPDATE TRX_TASK SET SIMSEM_ACCT_NO = #{simsemAcctNo}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{taskId} AND STATUS = N'EXECUTING'

UPDATE TRX_TASK SET SIMSEM_ACCT_NO = #{simsemAcctNo}, JOURNAL_NO_SIMSEM = #{journalNoSimsem}, TWO_LEG_STATE = N'LEG1_DONE', VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{taskId} AND STATUS = N'EXECUTING'
UPDATE TRX_TASK SET TWO_LEG_STATE = #{twoLegState}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT STATUS AS "status", TWO_LEG_STATE AS "twoLegState", SIMSEM_ACCT_NO AS "simsemAcctNo", JOURNAL_NO_SIMSEM AS "journalNoSimsem" FROM TRX_TASK WHERE ID = #{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TRX_TASK SET STATUS = N'EXECUTED', CORE_JOURNAL = #{coreJournal}, TRX_REF_NO = #{trxRefNo}, TWO_LEG_STATE = N'LEG2_DONE', EXECUTED_DT = SYSDATE, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{taskId} AND STATUS = N'UNKNOWN' AND TWO_LEG_STATE = N'LEG1_DONE'

UPDATE TRX_TASK SET STATUS = #{status}, TWO_LEG_STATE = #{twoLegState}, EXECUTED_DT = SYSDATE, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{taskId} AND STATUS = N'UNKNOWN' AND TWO_LEG_STATE = N'LEG1_DONE'
